list: The official 55 PS5 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden. Names, descriptions and grades cross-checked 2026-11-20 against Planet GTA 6 (Exophase + PSNProfiles + TrueAchievements) and Output Lag; counts cross-checked against Push Square. Five cryptic hidden trophies have no confirmed unlock method at launch and are marked unconfirmed.

sources.name: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements)
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: This is the Platinum: it pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, then the side-story finales, then the long collectible and activity counts — and check the progress bars at the top of this guide to see what is left. Expect a long haul: launch-week guides put the Platinum at roughly 200 to 300 hours, most of it the 100% completion checklist.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and finish it — the trophy pops when the mission ends. It is the first story trophy, so if you are just starting, simply follow the opening objectives and do not worry about anything else yet.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops as the chapter closes (chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene). One warning for later: while you are still in Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation — see Positive Mental Attitude — because that one spot disappears when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Chapter 2 is where the map really opens up: character switching between Jason and Lucia unlocks just after the Breakfast Run mission, and the Vice City Real Estate app (garages) and the Scooter Bros app open up during this chapter, so start the money and vehicle trophies here rather than leaving them all for after the story.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish Chapter 3. This is the chapter where robbery tools arrive: the mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies (needed for Sneakthief), and the street-racing strand's Race Against Yago is time-sensitive, so do it the moment it appears instead of putting it off.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish Chapter 4. Near the end of this chapter the optional mission That's Where The Money Is unlocks bank vault robberies, which you need for Maximum Withdrawal — bring your partner, because you cannot carry all the bags alone, and escaping a vault with your partner also sets up Hot Together.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy and one of only two golds. Finish the final mission and the trophy pops. Before you start it, keep one untouched manual save from just before the final mission: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus at launch, so that save is your safety net if anything before the ending was missed.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Character switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after this mission, which is what makes the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) possible, so from here on you can call the other character in as your partner.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist as part of the main story. No special preparation is needed — just play the mission through to its end.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission Child's Play as part of the main story. No special preparation is needed — just play the mission through to its end.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission Headliners as part of the main story. No special preparation is needed — just play the mission through to its end.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown as part of the main story. The mission takes place at Vice City International Airport, which is also where the free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can happens — but that one is a separate stunt you do on your own, not part of this mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory as part of the main story. No special preparation is needed — just play the mission through to its end.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the list and the second gold. Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which only appears after the story (Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion) — but work you do earlier still counts, so do not wait until the credits to start. 100% does not mean literally everything: for example there are 18 collectible card sets but only 15 count toward 100%, 397 stunts in total but 300 are needed, and 80 Challenges but 70 are needed. Finish the story first, then use the checklist itself as your to-do list and clear it category by category.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts come in four kinds — stunt jumps (130 in the game), under-the-bridge flights (202), knife flights (40) and base jumps (25) — 397 in total, so you need a little over half of them. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road. Find stunt spots on the map (Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots) and track progress at Touch Pad > Progress > Activities > Stunts.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. You do not need to win or finish anything — one try of each type is enough. As you explore Leonida, dip into every activity icon you see on the map (races, shooting ranges, fishing, arcade games, drone races and the rest) and the trophy pops once the ninth type has been tried. Check Touch Pad > Activities to see what you have and have not touched yet.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers to gold, and some are locked until you meet other conditions shown on the map. Find the ranges at Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges and track progress there. Take it one weapon and one tier at a time — there is no time limit, so replay a challenge until the gold score lands.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. You only need one win per location, not every race at every location. Some locations charge an entry fee, so keep some cash on hand. Find the locations at Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones, and work through them in any order — learn each course's turns on a first run, then race it properly on the next.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — winning the same race twenty times does not count. Race locations appear all over Leonida as you explore; track them at Touch Pad > Activities > Racing. Most locations let you hire a car: pay attention to its Rating, and upgrade your own car at Mod Shops if you bring it. Start with the shorter, easier circuits and save the trickier ones for when your driving and your car are better.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fairly early in the game Cal asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2 kg: fish in the area marked on your map until you land one big enough. You need a boat with a fishing rod — there are plenty around to borrow if you do not own one yet. This is also good practice for the fishing that feeds the 100% checklist, so do it when it appears rather than skipping it.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — any of the four in-game arcade games counts, and you only need to finish one. Find an arcade machine while exploring (arcades are among the activity spots on the map), sit down and play it through to the end. It also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so do it early.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's whole mission strand, ending with the final mission for Andy. Andy's questline is Lucia-only, and like the other side-story finales it stays available after the credits, so there is no rush — but finish it before you call the Platinum done. Work through Andy's missions as they appear and the trophy pops when the last one ends.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's whole mission strand, ending with the mission named Maritime Disputes. The side-story finales stay available after the credits, so this cannot be missed by finishing the story — just keep taking Kenton's missions until the strand ends and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's whole mission strand, ending with the mission named Hometown Heroes. The side-story finales stay available after the credits, so this cannot be missed by finishing the story — just keep taking Billy's missions until the strand ends and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger strands are the question-mark encounters scattered around the map; each strand is several missions long. Note that Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do NOT count here, because they have their own trophies — so you need eight other stranger strands. One strand to prioritise: the Chapter 3 street-racing strand, whose Race Against Yago is time-sensitive (hourglass icon), so race it the moment it appears. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's whole mission strand, ending with the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand involves finding vehicles on a wish list — Push Square's guide lists the wish-list vehicle locations if you get stuck on one. The side-story finales stay available after the credits, so finish the strand at your own pace.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's whole mission strand, ending with the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, and the Kitty Litter Lab locations Push Square lists help you progress it. The side-story finales stay available after the credits, so finish the strand at your own pace.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close, and a meditation only counts once the final 'zen' animation has played, so stay until it finishes. Track progress at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations, and find discovered spots at Touch Pad > Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida. POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the one real missable risk in the whole list: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears when Chapter 1 ends, so do it in Chapter 1 (after Lucia is home, follow her to the balcony of Jason's house in the morning and accept the optional task) and keep a Chapter 1 manual save until this trophy pops. Some guides also report that meditating at a spot with your partner counts for both characters, so bring your partner when you can.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks — follow Bret's missions until the unique animal is the target, then hunt it. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what the hunting quests reward. The questline stays available after the credits, so take it at your own pace.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. There are 18 card sets in the game, and you need every card in a set for it to count — start with the sets whose cards you already have most of. Cards can be sold at pawn shops and will still count toward your progress. Track sets at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards. If you are chasing 100% as well, 15 full sets are needed there, so this trophy pops along the way.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to open it) to scan 100 locations. Scannable spots fall into groups — landmarks (31), curiosities (35) and sculptures (23) — plus No Flusher tags, which make up the rest. Walk up to a landmark, open WAiNK and scan it; the app reveals extra information about the spot. Track progress at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations. Make a habit of scanning everything you pass while doing other things, and the 100 arrives without a dedicated grind.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's in-game achievement-style tasks, listed at Touch Pad > Progress > Challenges — there are 80 in total, and 70 are needed for 100% completion, so aim past 50 if you want A Long Road. Many complete on their own while you play the story and side content, so check the list regularly, pick off the ones closest to done, and let the rest fill in as you explore.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose the police and escape the red heat zone completely — the trophy pops once you are out of the heat, not just out of the flashing search area. The easiest setup is a bank vault robbery (see Maximum Withdrawal): vault jobs give you 4 stars straight away, so bring your partner and escape together and this pops with the vault trophy. Call your partner in before you start trouble, and do not let the stars drop before you are ready.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner with you, rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you — if the Wanted Level fades and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. Call your partner first, then hit three shops close together, one after another, without stopping to lose the cops in between. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before you rob a fourth. Pick shops near each other and plan the route before the first robbery.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. You discover a vehicle automatically when you get inside it, or when you scan it with the WAiNK app — so scan traffic as you drive and hop into anything new you see. This should happen naturally through the story, and you can track what you have found at Touch Pad > Progress > Vehicles. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100 if you are chasing A Long Road.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim — press L3 and R3 together while aiming. Pick a spot with a group of enemies close together, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle so you can drop several before Focus runs out. Adrenaline extends Focus, so use it if you have it. If you only get three or four, reload and try a bigger group.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport (VCIA), steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. The planes at gates E3 and E4 are reported to work. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off, then fly about 1 km away from the airport; the trophy is delayed and pops once you are that far out. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a military tank (a Rhino) and drive and fire it until the trophy pops. Tanks are reported to be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save before you go in — the area is guarded — then get in, drive around and fire the cannon until it pops. If the tanks are not there on your visit, leave and come back later rather than fighting the whole base on foot.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First you need the Snap Gun, which comes from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — that mission also opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it; kicking the door in sets off the alarm and ruins the attempt. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without anyone seeing you. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload the save rather than pushing on.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Bank vaults unlock through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Vault jobs give you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults, so keep going past 5 if you are chasing A Long Road.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — watch for one, block it or force it to stop, take the cash and get away before the police close in. The trophy pops once you have escaped, not when you open the truck, so plan your getaway route before you strike and do not hang around the scene.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — visit every area of the map until the trophy pops. There is no confirmed area count published in the guides checked, so do not chase a number: instead drive and fly through every region, including the smaller towns, the islands and the far southwest, until the map is fully revealed. Exploring also feeds Whip It Good (scan vehicles as you go) and You WAiNKer! (scan landmarks), so combine the three.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Illegal operations are the gang-run spots marked around the map — each gang owns some, and you need at least one from every gang, not nine from the same one. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations robbed, so this trophy pops along the way to A Long Road. Hit a different gang's operation each time and check which gangs you have covered.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no confirmed unlock method at launch. The description is the only hint: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so the likely trigger is ordering and drinking a cocktail at a bar or venue overlooking Ocean Beach in Vice City. Launch-week guides list this as one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed method, and it may pop while you play normally. Try the beachfront bars, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view — if it does not pop, keep the trophy in mind and try other Ocean Beach venues later.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no confirmed unlock method at launch. The description is the only hint: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in the style of the classic showroom-smash moment, so the likely trigger is driving a car through the glass front of a vehicle showroom and out the other side. Launch-week guides list this as one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed method. Pick a showroom, get a fast car, and drive straight through the front — save first, because you will earn police attention.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: This one is about the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, which is Kingpin Bowling — an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs and take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable — you can return and finish the job.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: REPORTED, NOT FULLY CONFIRMED — launch-week guides report this pops when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength, but the trigger has not been confirmed by a second source, so treat it as a strong lead, not a certainty. The reported method: buy a gym membership and train with your partner at a gym, since your partner trains alongside you, and keep training both characters until each one's Strength is at maximum. If it does not pop at max Strength for both, it may be tied to a story moment instead — keep playing and check back.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: REPORTED, NOT FULLY CONFIRMED — one guide reports this needs 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile, but that figure comes from a single source, so treat it as a lead, not a certainty. The reported idea is simple: robberies, fights and other crimes feed your Criminal Profile, so it should fill up on its own as you play through the story, the robberies and the illegal operations. Do not grind it separately — keep playing normally, check your profile progress, and it should pop during the long cleanup toward 100%.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no confirmed unlock method at launch. The description ('Second time's the charm') suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt — most likely retrying and then passing something you failed once. Launch-week guides list this as one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed method, and it may pop while you play normally. Do not force it: play on, retry anything you fail, and check back once more methods are confirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no confirmed unlock method at launch. The description ('What the hell just happened?') suggests witnessing something strange or unexpected in the world — a random event, an odd encounter, or a scripted surprise. Launch-week guides list this as one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed method, and it may pop while you play normally. Explore widely, pay attention to odd events and strangers, and check back once a confirmed trigger is published.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no confirmed unlock method at launch. The description is the only hint: bowl someone over with a melee drive-by, which most likely means hitting a person with a melee weapon while driving past in a vehicle. Launch-week guides list this as one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed method. The name is a bowling pun, so the bowling alley area is worth a try, but do not take that as confirmed — try a slow drive-by with a melee weapon equipped and check back once a method is published.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 in total laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — the total is cumulative, not in one go. Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them to your contacts to launder them. Bank vaults and armored trucks are good sources, so this builds up alongside Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play. Keep laundering after every big job rather than sitting on the bills.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops — cumulative across every kind of shop, so clothes, food, weapons, car upgrades and anything else all count. This is the easiest money trophy: just play normally and buy what you need, and it pops on its own. If you want it sooner, spend on things that also help other trophies — garage purchases count toward Little Boxes, and car upgrades help the racing trophies.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. The eight garages and their prices are: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue Garage $12,000; Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000; Persistence Road Garage $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court Garage $34,000; Atlantic Court Garage $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800 — $160,000 in total. Garages the story gives you do not count, and each garage adds one parking spot you need for registering vehicles (see On the Spot), so buy them before you start registering cars.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app opens in the Chapter 2 mission Moses: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes) and register cheap cars — Scooter Bros then delivers your repaired vehicles to you for a small fee. Register ten different vehicles and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: On the Spot
